5	/// Manages watchlist items and their airing status updates.
6	@MainActor
7	final class WatchlistManager: ObservableObject {
8	    /// Shared singleton instance.
9	    static let shared = WatchlistManager()
10	
11	    /// Key for storing last refresh date in UserDefaults.
12	    private static let lastRefreshKey = "watchlistLastRefresh"
13	
14	    /// The TMDB service for fetching airing info.
15	    private let tmdbService: TMDBService?
16	
17	    /// UserDefaults instance for storing refresh date.
18	    private let defaults: UserDefaults
19	
20	    /// Refresh policy for determining when to update airing info.
21	    let refreshPolicy: WatchlistRefreshPolicy
22	
23	    /// Published property to trigger UI updates when refresh completes.
24	    @Published private(set) var isRefreshing = false
25	
26	    /// Last refresh date, if any.
27	    var lastRefreshDate: Date? {
28	        get { defaults.object(forKey: Self.lastRefreshKey) as? Date }
29	        set { defaults.set(newValue, forKey: Self.lastRefreshKey) }
30	    }
31	
32	    /// Creates a WatchlistManager with the given dependencies.
33	    /// - Parameters:
34	    ///   - tmdbService: The TMDB service to use for fetching airing info.
35	    ///   - defaults: UserDefaults instance for storing refresh date.
36	    ///   - refreshPolicy: Policy for refresh timing. Defaults to 24-hour interval.
37	    init(
38	        tmdbService: TMDBService? = nil,
39	        defaults: UserDefaults = .standard,
40	        refreshPolicy: WatchlistRefreshPolicy = WatchlistRefreshPolicy()
41	    ) {
42	        self.tmdbService = tmdbService ?? (try? TMDBService())
43	        self.defaults = defaults
44	        self.refreshPolicy = refreshPolicy
45	    }
46	
47	    // MARK: - Add/Remove Operations
48	
49	    /// Adds a media item (TV show or movie) to the watchlist.
50	    /// - Parameters:
51	    ///   - media: The media item to add.
52	    ///   - context: The model context for persistence.
53	    ///   - posterData: Cached poster image data for widget display.
54	    /// - Returns: The created WatchlistItem, or nil if already in watchlist.
55	    @discardableResult
56	    func addToWatchlist(_ media: Media, context: ModelContext, posterData: Data? = nil) async -> WatchlistItem? {
57	        // Check if already in watchlist
58	        if isInWatchlist(mediaId: media.id, context: context) {
59	            return nil
60	        }
61	
62	        // For TV shows, fetch airing info
63	        var airingInfo: TVShowAiringInfo?
64	        if media.mediaType == .tv, let service = tmdbService {
65	            do {
66	                airingInfo = try await service.getTVShowAiringInfo(tvId: media.id)
67	            } catch {
68	                // Continue with nil airing info if fetch fails
69	            }
70	        }
71	
72	        // Create and insert the item
73	        let item = WatchlistItem(from: media, airingInfo: airingInfo, posterData: posterData)
74	        context.insert(item)
75	
76	        // Request notification permission if not yet determined
77	        await NotificationManager.shared.requestPermissionIfNeeded()
78	
79	        return item
80	    }
81	
82	    /// Removes a TV show from the watchlist.
83	    /// - Parameters:
84	    ///   - mediaId: The TMDB ID of the media to remove.
85	    ///   - context: The model context for persistence.
86	    /// - Returns: True if the item was removed, false if not found.
87	    @discardableResult
88	    func removeFromWatchlist(mediaId: Int, context: ModelContext) -> Bool {
89	        guard let item = fetchWatchlistItem(mediaId: mediaId, context: context) else {
90	            return false
91	        }
92	        context.delete(item)
93	
94	        // Cascade: delete all watched episode records for this show
95	        let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<WatchedEpisode>(
96	            predicate: #Predicate { $0.mediaId == mediaId }
97	        )
98	        if let episodes = try? context.fetch(descriptor) {
99	            for episode in episodes {
100	                context.delete(episode)
101	            }
102	        }
103	
104	        return true
105	    }
106	
107	    /// Checks if a media item is in the watchlist.
108	    /// - Parameters:
109	    ///   - mediaId: The TMDB ID to check.
110	    ///   - context: The model context to query.
111	    /// - Returns: True if the item is in the watchlist.
112	    func isInWatchlist(mediaId: Int, context: ModelContext) -> Bool {
113	        fetchWatchlistItem(mediaId: mediaId, context: context) != nil
114	    }
115	
116	    /// Fetches a specific watchlist item by media ID.
117	    /// - Parameters:
118	    ///   - mediaId: The TMDB ID to fetch.
119	    ///   - context: The model context to query.
120	    /// - Returns: The WatchlistItem if found, nil otherwise.
121	    func fetchWatchlistItem(mediaId: Int, context: ModelContext) -> WatchlistItem? {
122	        let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<WatchlistItem>(
123	            predicate: #Predicate { $0.mediaId == mediaId }
124	        )
125	        return try? context.fetch(descriptor).first
126	    }
127	
128	    /// Fetches all watchlist items.
129	    /// - Parameter context: The model context to query.
130	    /// - Returns: Array of all WatchlistItems.
131	    func fetchAllWatchlistItems(context: ModelContext) -> [WatchlistItem] {
132	        let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<WatchlistItem>(
133	            sortBy: [SortDescriptor(\.dateAdded, order: .reverse)]
134	        )
135	        return (try? context.fetch(descriptor)) ?? []
136	    }
137	
138	    // MARK: - Refresh Logic
139	
140	    /// Determines if a refresh is needed based on the last refresh date.
141	    /// - Parameter currentDate: The current date to compare against. Defaults to now.
142	    /// - Returns: True if refresh is needed (more than 24 hours since last refresh).
143	    func needsRefresh(currentDate: Date = Date()) -> Bool {
144	        refreshPolicy.needsRefresh(lastRefreshDate: lastRefreshDate, currentDate: currentDate)
145	    }
146	
147	    /// Refreshes airing info for all watchlist items if needed.
148	    /// - Parameters:
149	    ///   - context: The model context for persistence.
150	    ///   - force: If true, refreshes regardless of last refresh time.
151	    ///   - currentDate: The current date for refresh check. Defaults to now.
152	    func refreshIfNeeded(context: ModelContext, force: Bool = false, currentDate: Date = Date()) async {
153	        guard force || needsRefresh(currentDate: currentDate) else {
154	            return
155	        }
156	
157	        await refreshAllAiringInfo(context: context)
158	        lastRefreshDate = currentDate
159	    }
160	
161	    /// Refreshes airing info for all TV show watchlist items (movies are skipped).
162	    /// - Parameter context: The model context for persistence.
163	    func refreshAllAiringInfo(context: ModelContext) async {
164	        guard let service = tmdbService else { return }
165	
166	        isRefreshing = true
167	        defer { isRefreshing = false }
168	
169	        let items = fetchAllWatchlistItems(context: context)
170	
171	        for item in items {
172	            // Only refresh TV shows, not movies
173	            guard item.isTVShow else { continue }
174	
175	            do {
176	                let airingInfo = try await service.getTVShowAiringInfo(tvId: item.mediaId)
177	                item.update(with: airingInfo)
178	            } catch {
179	                // Keep existing data if refresh fails
180	            }
181	        }
182	
183	        // Explicitly save changes to persist updated airing info
184	        try? context.save()
185	
186	        // Reschedule episode notifications with updated airing data
187	        await NotificationManager.shared.rescheduleEpisodeNotifications(items: items)
188	    }
189	
190	    /// Refreshes airing info for a single watchlist item (TV shows only).
191	    /// - Parameters:
192	    ///   - item: The item to refresh.
193	    ///   - context: The model context for persistence.
194	    func refreshAiringInfo(for item: WatchlistItem, context: ModelContext) async {
195	        // Only refresh TV shows, not movies
196	        guard item.isTVShow, let service = tmdbService else { return }
197	
198	        do {
199	            let airingInfo = try await service.getTVShowAiringInfo(tvId: item.mediaId)
200	            item.update(with: airingInfo)
201	            try? context.save()
202	        } catch {
203	            // Keep existing data if refresh fails
204	        }
205	    }
206	
207	    // MARK: - Episode Tracking
208	
209	    /// Marks an episode as watched. Idempotent — no-op if already watched.
210	    func markEpisodeWatched(
211	        mediaId: Int,
212	        episodeId: Int,
213	        seasonNumber: Int,
214	        episodeNumber: Int,
215	        context: ModelContext
216	    ) {
217	        guard !isEpisodeWatched(episodeId: episodeId, context: context) else { return }
218	
219	        let record = WatchedEpisode(
220	            episodeId: episodeId,
221	            mediaId: mediaId,
222	            seasonNumber: seasonNumber,
223	            episodeNumber: episodeNumber
224	        )
225	        context.insert(record)
226	    }
227	
228	    /// Removes a watched episode record. No-op if not watched.
229	    func markEpisodeUnwatched(episodeId: Int, context: ModelContext) {
230	        let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<WatchedEpisode>(
231	            predicate: #Predicate { $0.episodeId == episodeId }
232	        )
233	        guard let record = try? context.fetch(descriptor).first else { return }
234	        context.delete(record)
235	    }
236	
237	    /// Toggles an episode's watched state.
238	    /// - Returns: `true` if the episode is now watched, `false` if unwatched.
239	    @discardableResult
240	    func toggleEpisodeWatched(
241	        mediaId: Int,
242	        episodeId: Int,
243	        seasonNumber: Int,
244	        episodeNumber: Int,
245	        context: ModelContext
246	    ) -> Bool {
247	        if isEpisodeWatched(episodeId: episodeId, context: context) {
248	            markEpisodeUnwatched(episodeId: episodeId, context: context)
249	            return false
250	        } else {
251	            markEpisodeWatched(
252	                mediaId: mediaId,
253	                episodeId: episodeId,
254	                seasonNumber: seasonNumber,
255	                episodeNumber: episodeNumber,
256	                context: context
257	            )
258	            return true
259	        }
260	    }
261	
262	    /// Checks whether a specific episode is marked as watched.
263	    func isEpisodeWatched(episodeId: Int, context: ModelContext) -> Bool {
264	        let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<WatchedEpisode>(
265	            predicate: #Predicate { $0.episodeId == episodeId }
266	        )
267	        let count = (try? context.fetchCount(descriptor)) ?? 0
268	        return count > 0
269	    }
270	
271	    /// Returns all watched episode records for a given show.
272	    func watchedEpisodes(for mediaId: Int, context: ModelContext) -> [WatchedEpisode] {
273	        let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<WatchedEpisode>(
274	            predicate: #Predicate { $0.mediaId == mediaId }
275	        )
276	        return (try? context.fetch(descriptor)) ?? []
277	    }
278	
279	    /// Returns the count of watched episodes for a specific season of a show.
280	    func watchedEpisodeCount(for mediaId: Int, seasonNumber: Int, context: ModelContext) -> Int {
281	        let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<WatchedEpisode>(
282	            predicate: #Predicate { $0.mediaId == mediaId && $0.seasonNumber == seasonNumber }
283	        )
284	        return (try? context.fetchCount(descriptor)) ?? 0
285	    }
286	
287	    /// Batch marks all episodes in a season as watched.
288	    func markSeasonWatched(mediaId: Int, episodes: [Episode], context: ModelContext) {
289	        for episode in episodes {
290	            markEpisodeWatched(
291	                mediaId: mediaId,
292	                episodeId: episode.id,
293	                seasonNumber: episode.seasonNumber,
294	                episodeNumber: episode.episodeNumber,
295	                context: context
296	            )
297	        }
298	    }
299	
300	    /// Batch removes all watched episode records for a specific season of a show.
301	    func markSeasonUnwatched(mediaId: Int, seasonNumber: Int, context: ModelContext) {
302	        let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<WatchedEpisode>(
303	            predicate: #Predicate { $0.mediaId == mediaId && $0.seasonNumber == seasonNumber }
304	        )
305	        guard let episodes = try? context.fetch(descriptor) else { return }
306	        for episode in episodes {
307	            context.delete(episode)
308	        }
309	    }
310	
311	}

47	        self.runtime = runtime
48	    }

53	extension Episode {
54	    /// Full URL for the episode still image.
55	    public var stillURL: URL? {
56	        guard let stillPath else { return nil }
57	        return URL(string: "https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/w300\(stillPath)")
58	    }

61	    public var formattedRuntime: String? {
62	        guard let runtime, runtime > 0 else { return nil }
63	        return "\(runtime) min"
64	    }
65	
66	    /// Whether this episode has aired (air date is today or in the past).
67	    /// Returns true if air date is nil (unknown defaults to aired).
68	    public var hasAired: Bool {
69	        guard let airDate else { return true }
70	        let parser = DateFormatter()
71	        parser.dateFormat = "yyyy-MM-dd"
72	        parser.locale = Locale(identifier: "en_US_POSIX")
73	        guard let date = parser.date(from: airDate) else { return true }
74	        return date <= Calendar.current.startOfDay(for: Date()).addingTimeInterval(86400 - 1)
75	    }

78	    public var formattedAirDate: String? {
79	        guard let airDate else { return nil }
80	        let parser = DateFormatter()
81	        parser.dateFormat = "yyyy-MM-dd"
82	        parser.locale = Locale(identifier: "en_US_POSIX")
83	        guard let date = parser.date(from: airDate) else { return nil }
84	        let formatter = DateFormatter()
85	        formatter.dateStyle = .full
86	        formatter.timeStyle = .none
87	        return formatter.string(from: date)
88	    }

6	/// Manages local notification scheduling, permissions, and badge state.
7	@MainActor
8	final class NotificationManager: ObservableObject {
9	    static let shared = NotificationManager()
10	
11	    /// Whether the user has granted notification permission.
12	    @Published private(set) var isAuthorized = false
13	
14	    /// Media to navigate to when a notification is tapped.
15	    @Published var pendingMediaId: Int?
16	    @Published var pendingMediaType: MediaType?
17	
18	    /// UserDefaults key for user's notification toggle.
19	    private static let notificationsEnabledKey = "notificationsEnabled"
20	
21	    /// UserDefaults key for the last time the user opened the app.
22	    private static let lastOpenedDateKey = "lastOpenedDate"
23	
24	    /// The last time the user brought the app to the foreground.
25	    /// Used as the baseline for badge count calculation. Defaults to `.distantPast`
26	    /// so that first-launch users see badges for all pending notifications.
27	    var lastOpenedDate: Date {
28	        get {
29	            let interval = UserDefaults.standard.double(forKey: Self.lastOpenedDateKey)
30	            return interval > 0 ? Date(timeIntervalSince1970: interval) : .distantPast
31	        }
32	        set {
33	            UserDefaults.standard.set(newValue.timeIntervalSince1970, forKey: Self.lastOpenedDateKey)
34	        }
35	    }
36	
37	    /// Whether the user has enabled notifications in app settings.
38	    var notificationsEnabled: Bool {
39	        get { UserDefaults.standard.bool(forKey: Self.notificationsEnabledKey) }
40	        set { UserDefaults.standard.set(newValue, forKey: Self.notificationsEnabledKey) }
41	    }
42	
43	    private init() {
44	        Task { await refreshAuthorizationStatus() }
45	    }
46	
47	    // MARK: - Permission
48	
49	    /// Requests notification permission from the user.
50	    func requestPermission() async -> Bool {
51	        do {
52	            let granted = try await UNUserNotificationCenter.current()
53	                .requestAuthorization(options: [.alert, .badge, .sound])
54	            isAuthorized = granted
55	            if granted {
56	                notificationsEnabled = true
57	            }
58	            return granted
59	        } catch {
60	            return false
61	        }
62	    }
63	
64	    /// Requests permission if not yet determined. Called after first watchlist save.
65	    func requestPermissionIfNeeded() async {
66	        let settings = await UNUserNotificationCenter.current().notificationSettings()
67	        guard settings.authorizationStatus == .notDetermined else { return }
68	        _ = await requestPermission()
69	    }
70	
71	    /// Refreshes the current authorization status.
72	    func refreshAuthorizationStatus() async {
73	        let settings = await UNUserNotificationCenter.current().notificationSettings()
74	        isAuthorized = settings.authorizationStatus == .authorized
75	    }
76	
77	    /// Whether notifications should be active (authorized + enabled).
78	    func shouldScheduleNotifications() -> Bool {
79	        isAuthorized && notificationsEnabled
80	    }
81	
82	    // MARK: - Episode Notifications
83	
84	    /// Reschedules episode notifications for all TV shows with upcoming episodes.
85	    /// Badge values are based on episodes airing after `lastOpenedDate`, not on
86	    /// Notification Center state. This prevents badge inflation across scheduling runs.
87	    func rescheduleEpisodeNotifications(items: [WatchlistItem]) async {
88	        guard shouldScheduleNotifications() else { return }
89	
90	        let center = UNUserNotificationCenter.current()
91	
92	        // Remove all existing episode notifications
93	        let pendingRequests = await center.pendingNotificationRequests()
94	        let episodeIds = pendingRequests
95	            .filter { $0.identifier.hasPrefix("episode-") }
96	            .map(\.identifier)
97	        center.removePendingNotificationRequests(withIdentifiers: episodeIds)
98	
99	        // Build content for all eligible episodes
100	        var contentItems: [(content: NotificationContent, airDate: Date)] = []
101	        for item in items where item.isTVShow {
102	            guard let airDate = item.nextEpisodeDate else { continue }
103	
104	            guard let content = NotificationContentBuilder.episodeNotification(
105	                mediaId: item.mediaId,
106	                title: item.title,
107	                seasonNumber: item.nextSeasonNumber,
108	                episodeNumber: item.nextEpisodeNumber,
109	                episodeName: item.nextEpisodeName,
110	                airDate: airDate
111	            ) else { continue }
112	
113	            contentItems.append((content, airDate))
114	        }
115	
116	        // Schedule chronologically so badge values (1, 2, 3...) match air order
117	        let sortedItems = contentItems.sorted { $0.airDate < $1.airDate }
118	        var badgeOffset = 0
119	        for (content, airDate) in sortedItems {
120	            if airDate > lastOpenedDate {
121	                badgeOffset += 1
122	                await scheduleNotification(content, badgeCount: badgeOffset)
123	            } else {
124	                await scheduleNotification(content)
125	            }
126	        }
127	    }
128	
129	    // MARK: - Movie Availability Notifications
130	
131	    /// Creates a notification for a movie that is now available to stream.
132	    /// Badge count accounts for any pending episode notifications that will fire
133	    /// after `lastOpenedDate`, plus this movie notification.
134	    func notifyMovieAvailable(item: WatchlistItem, serviceName: String) async {
135	        guard shouldScheduleNotifications() else { return }
136	
137	        let content = NotificationContentBuilder.movieAvailableNotification(
138	            mediaId: item.mediaId,
139	            title: item.title,
140	            serviceName: serviceName
141	        )
142	
143	        // Count pending episode notifications that will fire after lastOpenedDate
144	        let center = UNUserNotificationCenter.current()
145	        let pendingRequests = await center.pendingNotificationRequests()
146	        let episodeCount = pendingRequests
147	            .filter { $0.identifier.hasPrefix("episode-") }
148	            .compactMap { $0.trigger as? UNCalendarNotificationTrigger }
149	            .compactMap { (trigger: UNCalendarNotificationTrigger) -> Date? in
150	                Calendar.current.date(from: trigger.dateComponents)
151	            }
152	            .filter { $0 > lastOpenedDate }
153	            .count
154	
155	        await scheduleNotification(content, badgeCount: episodeCount + 1)
156	    }
157	
158	    // MARK: - Scheduling
159	
160	    /// Schedules a local notification from NotificationContent metadata.
161	    /// - Parameters:
162	    ///   - content: The notification metadata to schedule.
163	    ///   - badgeCount: The badge count to display. When nil, the notification
164	    ///     does not modify the app badge (used for episodes before lastOpenedDate).
165	    private func scheduleNotification(_ content: NotificationContent, badgeCount: Int? = nil) async {
166	        let notificationContent = UNMutableNotificationContent()
167	        notificationContent.title = content.title
168	        notificationContent.body = content.body
169	        notificationContent.categoryIdentifier = content.categoryIdentifier
170	        notificationContent.threadIdentifier = content.threadIdentifier
171	        notificationContent.sound = .default
172	        notificationContent.userInfo = [
173	            "mediaId": content.mediaId,
174	            "mediaType": content.mediaType
175	        ]
176	
177	        if let badgeCount {
178	            notificationContent.badge = NSNumber(value: badgeCount)
179	        }
180	
181	        // Create trigger
182	        let trigger: UNNotificationTrigger?
183	        if let triggerDate = content.triggerDate {
184	            let components = Calendar.current.dateComponents(
185	                [.year, .month, .day, .hour, .minute],
